mapper.sql: r.*, d.name AS dept_name, p.name AS position_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_candidate c WHERE c.recruit_id = r.id) AS candidate_count
FROM hr_recruit r LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = r.dept_id LEFT JOIN hr_position p ON p.id = r.position_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.create_by
mapper.update: UPDATE hr_recruit SET status = CASE WHEN hired_count + 1 >= headcount THEN 'CLOSED' ELSE status END, hired_count = hired_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN'
